title: FRAMEWORKERS: A Dynamic Multi-Agent Framework for AI-Generated Video Production
abstract: arXiv:2608.29814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern video generators excel at synthesizing individual clips, but complete video production requires coordinating a long sequence of interdependent creative steps, including scripting, storyboarding, generation, and editing. It further demands persistent asset management and dynamic task orchestration as intermediate outputs, dependencies, and execution states evolve over time. Existing automated systems typically rely on rigid pipelines that are difficult to adapt to diverse inputs and changing workflows, while general-purpose large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable for long-horizon orchestration and multimodal asset routing. We introduce FRAMEWORKERS, a task-centric and workspace-grounded multi-agent framework for open-ended video production. A central Director formulates video creation as dynamic task management, continuously editing a Task Stack to determine which subtask to execute next and which sub-agent to invoke. An Ass

translated_title: FRAMEWORKERS：面向AI生成视频制作的动态多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 现代视频生成器擅长合成单个视频片段，但完整的视频制作需要协调一长串相互依赖的创作步骤，包括剧本撰写、分镜设计、生成和剪辑。随着中间输出、依赖关系和执行状态随时间演变，它还要求持续的资产管理和动态任务编排。现有自动化系统通常依赖僵化的流水线，难以适应多样化的输入和不断变化的工作流程，而通用大语言模型（LLMs）在长时程编排和多模态资产路由方面仍然不可靠。我们提出FRAMEWORKERS，一个以任务为中心、以工作区为基础的开放式视频制作多智能体框架。中央Director（导演）智能体将视频创作建模为动态任务管理，通过持续编辑任务栈来决定下一步执行哪个子任务以及调用哪个子智能体。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FRAMEWORKERS多智能体框架，由中央导演智能体动态编辑任务栈来编排子智能体并依托工作区进行多模态资产管理，从而解决AI视频制作中长流程协调与动态任务调度难题。
